audit.why: Chart (Skill/Singed/Singed/Skill/Skill/Singed/Singed) already matches the 53.38% win rate and matches audits/top/galio__singed.json exactly — no flip needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike is written about Shield of Durand, which Galio has from Level 1, and never mentions Hero's Entrance or Insanity Potion.
audit.why: Neither champion's level-6 spike was described. Hero's Entrance is a map ability that does nothing to a proxying Singed; Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which is the real 6 swing here.
audit.corrected: Rewrite spikes[1] and phases[4].why around Hero's Entrance being off-lane and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mega Adhesive's grounding is never stated. The page treats Justice Punch purely as a cooldown to dodge and the glue purely as a slow.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive grounds (17/16/15/14/13s, 1000 range) and grounding shuts off dashes. Justice Punch is Galio's only gap-closer AND only escape, so one glue throw denies both. Fling (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, 125 range) roots the target if the landing spot is inside Mega Adhesive. The mirror page states both from Galio's side.
audit.corrected: Glue first to ground Justice Punch, then Fling him into the glue for the root.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Late spike says 'your Mega Adhesive roots him if he tries to leave'. Mega Adhesive alone only slows and grounds.
audit.why: Riot text: the root only happens when Fling drops the target into the Mega Adhesive. Telling a player the glue roots on its own will get them killed waiting for CC that never lands.
audit.corrected: Glue grounds and slows; the root requires the Fling landing inside it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block gives no numbers and frames Justice Punch as something to dodge rather than something to deny.
audit.why: Real numbers make it actionable and grounding is the actual answer.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive 17s at rank 1 grounds it; Fling 10s at rank 1.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: his only gap-closer and his only escape — Mega Adhesive (17s at rank 1) grounds it, so it will not cast at all while he is standing in the glue. - Your Fling: 10s at rank 1, and it roots if it drops him in the goo.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — Fling into goo, poison out.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds Justice Punch — his dash will not cast at all. Glue first, Fling him into it, the landing roots him.

edits.before: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only gap-closer and escape. Mega Adhesive grounds it, so glued he cannot dash at all.

edits.before: Galio wastes Justice Punch — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Fling puts him behind you; land him in the glue and he is rooted.

edits.before: Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon — you win by farming where he is not. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Galio's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is a map tool, not a lane answer — keep proxying. Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds to him.

edits.before: Galio's W (Shield of Durand) taunt absorbs your Fling window and his MR stack makes Insanity Potion burst feel thin — respect this window and play for position, not kills.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is a map ability — his 6 swings other lanes, not this one. Yours swings here: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds through his sustain.

edits.before: Liandry's Anguish burn ticks through Galio's MR over the duration of a proxy — he has to burn his E to disengage and your Mega Adhesive roots him if he tries to leave.
edits.after: Liandry's burn ticks through Galio's MR over a proxy — and Mega Adhesive grounds Justice Punch, so he cannot dash out at all. Fling him into the glue and the landing roots him.

edits.before: Shield of Durand at full rank absorbs your Fling and taunts you through his passive auto and Q damage — avoid extended all-ins and take short poison-kite trades only.
edits.after: Shield of Durand absorbs a Fling and taunts you, and Hero's Entrance is a map play rather than a lane one — take short poison-kite trades and glue his exit instead.

notes: Mirror audits/top/galio__singed.json already fixed the Galio side; level charts agree on both sides and were left alone.
